serverInfo.name: openaccountants-mcp
serverInfo.title: OpenAccountants
serverInfo.description: Tax skills for answering tax questions in 190+ jurisdictions (countries, US states, Canadian provinces): income tax, company and freelancer tax, VAT/GST and US sales tax, payroll, deductions, filing deadlines, crypto, capital gains, residency and moving countries (non-dom, NHR/IFICI, Beckham, 30% ruling, UK SRT and more). Every skill sets out the method, cites the official source for its figures, and says whether a licensed accountant has reviewed it.
